prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 高一学生期中期末成绩汇总 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "姓名" spans 1 col × 2 row; "语文" spans 2 col × 1 row; "数学" spans 2 col × 1 row; "英语" spans 2 col × 1 row; "总分" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "语文 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "语文 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "数学 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "数学 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 6: header "英语 › 期中" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 7: header "英语 › 期末" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 8: header "总分" · longest unbreakable word 28px · one-line width 31px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 432px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 431px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总六名高一学生的期中、期末各科成绩及总分，便于查看个人表现和比较学生之间的成绩。","reading":"按行查看每名学生的各科成绩与总分；按列比较不同学生，并在同一学科内比较期中与期末。","groups":["姓名是行标识，应与该行成绩保持清晰关联。","语文、数学、英语各自的期中和期末列构成一组；六列作用相同，适合采用一致的宽度。","总分是每行的综合结果，应便于单独定位和跨行比较。"],"keep_intact":["两位数成绩和三位数总分应保持在同一行。","学生姓名宜保持完整，以便快速识别行。"],"may_wrap":["空间不足时，姓名可在汉字之间换行，但会增加数据行高度并削弱快速识别。","期中、期末可在汉字之间换行；表头已有两层，增加表头高度可避免压缩数据行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [67, 52, 52, 52, 52, 52, 52, 52] · table 432×291px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/11 · tallest cell 1 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [52, 54, 54, 54, 54, 54, 54, 55] · table 432×431px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/11 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [67, 49, 49, 49, 49, 49, 49, 70] · table 432×314px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 6/11 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"姓名、成绩、总分和两层表头均保持单行；六个成绩列等宽，三个学科组的节奏一致，便于逐行阅读和跨列比较。整表紧凑且各行高度一致。","problems":"没有明显的排版问题；表格宽度接近视口上限，但仍在允许范围内。","cause":"姓名列为67px，恰好容纳46px内容及21px内边距和边框；六个成绩列和总分列均为52px，各有31px内容空间，足以容纳相应的单行内容。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"六个成绩列等宽，期中、期末表头和所有分数保持单行，学科分组清楚。","problems":"所有姓名都折成两行，六个数据行因此变高；姓名识别和逐行扫描都变慢，表格也显得松散。","cause":"姓名列仅52px，扣除21px内边距和边框后只剩31px，容不下最长46px的姓名；与此同时，成绩列和总分列分别达到54px和55px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"姓名和分数均保持单行，数据行高度一致；六个成绩列等宽，学科分组仍然清晰。","problems":"六个期中、期末表头全部折成两行，增加表头高度并削弱横向扫描；总分列相对其他数字列显得过宽。","cause":"六个成绩列各为49px，扣除21px后只有28px，少于表头单行所需的31px；总分列为70px，超过其单行内容所需宽度。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
